formal: I injured my knee while running and have been performing physiotherapy exercises for three weeks. The pain has subsided over the past few days. My plan is to discontinue the physiotherapy exercises and resume my usual 10k runs next week. I am clear about what I want from my running and my weekly routine, and I have made this decision myself. It is unusual for me to ask you about my running or my knee, and I rarely bring decisions to you. What is your view?
